title: seriphidium leucodes
intro: Seriphidium leucodes, commonly known as Sichuan fennel or mountain fennel, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Seriphidium leucodes include reducing fever, alleviating pain and inflammation, and supporting respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
